title: Unreal 2 Strawberry and Peach 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Strawberry and Peach from Unreal 2 e-liquids offers an irresistible taste of summer with a blend of soft, ripe, succulent strawberries and the juicy tang of sun-ripened peaches. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mod vapes and sub-ohm tanks .
